expand_tensor: expand a tensor, list, or dict by repeating along the batch dimension for a given number of frames
slice_tensor: slice a tensor, list, or dict to extract the first batch element across frames
load_scannet_data: load and process ScanNet-style 3D point cloud data with voxelization, segmentation, and grounding targets
prepare_targets: prepare detection and grounding targets from video instances with open-vocabulary class mapping
test_expand_tensor: test the expand_tensor function with a batch-size-one tensor and verify repetition across frames
